service.description: The work centers of the user's organizations (facilityId, facilityIds, the centers of plantFacilityId, or those whose id or name has text, ignoring case), a page at a time, each with its parallel slots and rate capacities, its efficiency and, over the range and in each period of it (bucket day or week; the whole range by default): nominal hours (the slots over the whole period at its efficiency), calendar-adjusted hours (over its work hours less the holidays of its calendar and organization), downtime hours (the work hours it is offline: production stops and the outages of the center or its equipment), available hours (calendar-adjusted less downtime), booked hours (each released operation's standard hours, machine time where it has it, else labor, for the run's output quantity, prorated over the work hours of its dates in the period; one without dates counts whole in the first period), overload and utilization (booked over available, not OEE). Each center names its missing data (no calendar, no slots, operations without hours or dates, stops awaiting approval counted as downtime, an open stop or outage), its next available time (within 60 days) and its offline reason now or next. loadHours is the booked hours. The range is fromDate (now) through thruDate (two weeks on), at most a year, and at most 62 periods. Needs PRODUCTION_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED); a facilityId of another organization or that is not a work center is refused like a missing one (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: facilityIds
parameter.description: Work centers, a list or ids separated by commas

parameter.name: bucket
parameter.description: day, week, or empty for the whole range

service.description: The schedule of the user's work centers (the centers of plantFacilityId, or facilityIds; at most 30) from fromDate (the start of today) through thruDate (two weeks on; at most three months): each lane (center) with its slots, whether it has a calendar, the times it does not work (closedList), its holidays and its offline intervals (stops and outages, with their reasons); the released operations at the centers (at most 300) with their run, product, hours, dates, status, whether actual work locks them, their predecessors, their revisions, whether the user may move them and the conflicts of where they are now; the operations at the centers with no dates (unscheduledList); the conflicts listed; the override requests waiting at the centers (and scheduleChangeId's); and whether the user may schedule (PRODUCTION_SCHEDULE) and override (PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE). Dates are text in the user's zone (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm). Needs PRODUCTION_VIEW, PRODUCTION_SCHEDULE or PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE (PERMISSION_DENIED); RANGE_INVALID.

parameter.name: facilityIds
parameter.description: Work centers, a list or ids separated by commas

service.description: Move one released operation to a work center and dates, or unschedule it (design-manufacturing ProductionSchedule Move, Operations' Reschedule). action: - preview (default; PRODUCTION_SCHEDULE or PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE): writes nothing; answers where it is and where it would go (facilityId, the operation's by default; startDate, its own by default; endDate, else its standard hours over the center's work hours from the start), its hours, the refusals and conflicts, its revisions and whether the user may apply it, must override or may ask for an override; - apply (PRODUCTION_SCHEDULE): with the operation and its run locked, rechecks it all and writes the operation's center and dates, a ProductionScheduleChange and the run's people's notice. Refused, never overridden: the operation or center not available (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, CENTER_UNAVAILABLE), a center that is not its routing's or an alternate of it (CENTER_NOT_QUALIFIED), started or done work or a run not open (OPERATION_LOCKED), dates out of order (DATES_INVALID), revisions not given or changed (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED: expectedRevision is the operation's schedule revision, expectedRunRevision the run's, which a quantity or method change moves). Conflicts (calendar, offline, capacity, predecessor, successor, equipment, skills) refuse it (SCHEDULE_CONFLICT) unless override is true, which needs PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE (OVERRIDE_NOT_PERMITTED) and a reason (REASON_REQUIRED); an override changes no capacity and is kept on the change (overrideApplied); - unschedule (PRODUCTION_SCHEDULE): clears its dates (NOT_SCHEDULED, OPERATION_LOCKED, the revisions); - request (PRODUCTION_SCHEDULE): a move with conflicts, with a reason, waits for a supervisor (SchRequested) and notifies the organization's PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE holders (ProductionScheduleOverride; NO_CONFLICT); - approve and refuse (PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE) a request by scheduleChangeId: approve applies it with the override after the same rechecks at the revisions it was asked at (REVISION_CHANGED, CHANGE_DECIDED); refuse needs a reason. Both mark the requests read. Writes take an operationKey, and a retry answers the first result.

A planned offline time of a work center (design-manufacturing FacilityDetail "Offline changes warn or reschedule affected operations with an explicit preview"): a ResourceUnavailability RukPlanned of the facility, the minimal record Maintenance MT-07 extends. action: - preview (PRODUCTION_SCHEDULE or METHOD_RESOURCES): the open operations at the center that fromDate to thruDate overlaps, each with where it would move (forward to the center's first free time after the block and after its moved predecessors, within its slots), or why it stays (started work is never moved); - apply: records the block with its reason (REASON_REQUIRED) and, with moveOperations (PRODUCTION_SCHEDULE), applies each move through schedule#ProductionOperation in its own transaction, one that fails named with its reason and the others going on (moveResults); - withdraw a planned block of the center by resourceUnavailabilityId (the row in force when Maintenance corrected it): one not started ends at its start, one started ends now (OFFLINE_ENDED). Posted labor and machine facts are never changed. DATES_REQUIRED, DATES_INVALID, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE. Writes take an operationKey, and a retry answers the first result.
